method: Read-only live OpenBMC adapter benchmark, unoptimized test binary, first run then two repeats. No cache eviction; first sample is not a controlled cold-cache measurement. BitBake source lookup and UI redraw time are excluded.
behavior: Packages publish through an authority/generation-guarded preview while BitBake metadata acquisition proceeds concurrently. Full filesystem and service inventory replaces the preview only for the same pending request.
reproduce: Set explicit YOCTUI_ROOTFS_BENCH_BUILD, MACHINE, IMAGE, ARTIFACT, MANIFEST, PKGDATA, ROOTFS environment variables; cargo test --locked -p yoctui --bin yoctui rootfs_live_package_loading_benchmark -- --ignored --nocapture
limits: Missing exact manifest or workspace pkgdata retains the authoritative metadata path. No guessed source paths, image mounting, builds, daemon restarts or persistent scan cache.
